# manta_node (Resource)

Node represents a single node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "manta_node" "node" {
  id    = node.xname
  state = "On"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `state` (String) Power state, either "On" or "Off"

### Read-Only

- `arch` (String)
- `class` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `flag` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nettype` (String)
- `nid` (Number)
- `role` (String)
- `type` (String)
